parts.text: (a) Complete the table of sequences of consecutive positive integers. Sequence Number of terms Median Sum of all the terms 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 7 6 7, 8 2 7.5 20, 21, 22, ........ , 40 21 30 630 5, 6, 7 18 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 8 6 4.5 27 5 7

content.tex: Explain how to calculate the sum of all the terms using only the number of terms and the median.
What is always true about the number of terms when the median is an integer?
What is always true about the median when the number of terms is even?
